獨自修煉 · what the System is

a solo leveling homage, in our own ink

In Solo Leveling, the weakest hunter alive is given a System no one else can see: daily quests, ranks, penalties — and by training alone, every single day, he becomes the strongest. The manhwa's secret is not the monsters. It is the dailiness.

Looking at art works the same way. Nobody watches you do it. There is no audience, no leaderboard, no proof — only you, one work, and twenty honest seconds. Do it daily and something levels up that has no stat window.

So: a System for the one who looks. Three works a day, chosen by the calendar. Gaze at each — really gaze, the timer is watching — then read one placard. Rank rises from E toward S. Shadows of everything you have truly beheld follow you. 最弱嘅獵人日日獨自修煉，最後成為最強——秘密唔喺怪物，喺「日日」。
